purpose: Track bounded similarity comparisons for numbered Agda proof families without treating similarity as proof equivalence.

authority.sympy_role: optional secondary normalization for extracted algebraic expressions only

repository_intelligence_sqlite.note: Do not launch a full cold rebuild until a bounded selected-proof scope is defined.

comparison_pipeline.name: package-selection
comparison_pipeline.method: Choose a small number of semantic families and canonical-owner neighborhoods from the precomputed JSONL.

comparison_pipeline.name: exact-hash-grouping
comparison_pipeline.method: Group selected declarations by signature_sha256 and body_sha256.

comparison_pipeline.name: symbol-presence-bidi
comparison_pipeline.method: Compare exact and normalized declaration-name presence first, then signature-hash and body-hash presence; use import/dependency presence as the final structural discriminator.
comparison_pipeline.interpretation: A missing normalized symbol name is a difference signal, not evidence that two bodies are unrelated.

comparison_pipeline.name: structural-similarity
comparison_pipeline.method: Run tools/agda_preflight discovery similarity only within the selected proof set.

comparison_pipeline.name: optional-expression-normalization
comparison_pipeline.method: Use SymPy only on explicitly extracted numeric/algebraic expressions; retain source spans and never infer Agda equivalence.

comparison_pipeline.name: manual-owner-review
comparison_pipeline.method: Check imports, declarations, provenance, canonical owners, and residual status before proposing a rename tranche.

comparison_pipeline.name: formal-validation
comparison_pipeline.method: Use the sanctioned Agda entrypoint after any actual rename or alias change.

ym.evidence: After excluding empty body hashes, the largest YM body-hash groups are 111, 98, and 64 packages.
ym.next_action: Inspect the largest body-hash groups and partition by canonical owner before naming.

ns.evidence: These are the largest NS package families; the broadest body-hash groups are too cross-family to rename without owner and source review.
ns.next_action: Start with one five-module sample per family, then expand only when hash and import evidence agree.

ym_body_hash_groups.disposition: historical-superseded-exact; prioritize canonical-owner/source-location reconciliation, not direct rename
historical-superseded-exact; prioritize canonical-owner/source-location reconciliation, not direct rename
mixed-unresolved-frontier; do not rename until residuals and canonical owners are reconciled

first_pass_results.next_bounded_operation: Compare imports and source locations for groups 1-2, then separately route group 3 residuals; no rename tranche is safe from body hashes alone.

symbol_presence_bidi.normalization: Replace RoundNNN and literalRoundNNN with placeholders; preserve the remaining semantic stem.

current_sample.interpretation: Name presence is not sufficient; groups 1 and 2 retain one shared signature surface despite disjoint normalized names.

symbol_presence_bidi.decision: Use a layered presence/difference vector rather than an all-pairs name-similarity matrix.

wall_time_notes.cold_preflight: one YM target exceeded 90 seconds; avoid full-corpus cold benchmarking until scope is bounded
